_comment: The recurring jobs a fresh installation gets from `jori setup` (lib/onboarding/core.mjs installStarterSchedule). Only jobs that work with the core alone: a Claude sign-in, the local memory and the watchdog. Every other job in system/tasks.json waits until its integration is set up and is then turned on from the control room's Schedule page. A name is a task in system/tasks.json (schedule and trigger_script come from there); an entry with its own `script` is a crontab line with no task of its own. Lines are tagged `# jori-starter` and a job whose `--label` is already in the crontab is never added twice. `when` groups a job on the setup page's routine (morning, day, evening, night, background). An entry with `requires` waits until one of those services is connected (lib/onboarding/services.mjs) and is added when the setup page connects it.
